replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body:
That's not block lag, that's someone with a too much TNT, if I'm not mistaken, which is out of most servers' control. The map developers will have a look at it I hope.

Regarding the OP and others experiencing this kind of lag, give 1.8.avic.us a shot, but make sure you are on DTM01. Note that many types of lag are out of our control because of latency. When you place a block, it sends information to the server, processes it, sends this info to you and all the other players on the server. The time it takes to go between places (you to the server, to the players) is out of our control. The processing done on the server is, on the other hand. We've been eliminating any sources that may cause it on our part, and we're about there!
